relationships.subject: anti-CGRP monoclonal antibodies
relationships.evidence_quote: The anti-calcitonin gene-related peptide monoclonal antibodies (anti-CGRP-mAb) are effective in migraine

relationships.subject: anti-CGRP monoclonal antibodies
relationships.evidence_quote: We recorded modest improvements in headache outcomes, although significant results were only observed in those that switched anti-CGRP-mAb due to ineffectiveness.

key_findings: Switching anti-CGRP mAbs in chronic migraine gave non-significant red-day reductions overall (-1.2 days), with 15% achieving >=50% improvement.
Significant headache reductions were seen only in those who switched due to ineffectiveness.
